preconditions.description: Number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^4.
The adjacency list has exactly V elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(adj[i], list) for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: Each element in the adjacency list is a list.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 if all(len(adj[i]) % 2 == 0 for i in range(V)) else False
postconditions.description: The graph contains an Eulerian Circuit if every vertex has even degree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if sum(1 for i in range(V) if len(adj[i]) % 2 != 0) == 2 else False
postconditions.description: The graph contains an Eulerian Path if exactly two vertices have odd degree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if sum(1 for i in range(V) if len(adj[i]) % 2 != 0) != 2 and not all(len(adj[i]) % 2 == 0 for i in range(V)) else False
postconditions.description: The graph contains neither an Eulerian Path nor an Eulerian Circuit if more than two vertices have odd degree or if not all vertices have even degree.
